title: Rain before Breakfast
story: It started to rain while Mateo made breakfast. He had left the windows open, so the curtains got wet. He closed them and wiped the floor with a towel. Then he saw his neighbour outside without a coat. Mateo took a spare umbrella from the hall and crossed the street. The neighbour smiled and promised to return it after work. Mateo went back to his toast.
